thread:
Alex: heads-up — saw 5 client errors during the mux-policy flip this morning. symptoms: requests hit fallback path and downstream rejects due to missing mux header
Priya: ugh. which SDKs/versions?
Alex: mostly py 1.4.2 and node 2.0.0-canary. logs show `x-rd-mux` absent after the automatic retry flow
Jordan: right now our retry layer intentionally strips unknown headers for safety during proxy handoffs. we flagged mux as non-safe historically
Priya: we treated x-rd-mux as advisory routing info, not auth. should be safe to preserve across internal retries (it's ephemeral id only) :shrug:
Jordan: the problem is the SDK retry is done by an internal proxy that reissues the request, not our client lib. proxy code clears all non-whitelisted headers:
Alex: example from logs: ```[2026-03-21T08:12:03Z] incoming: x-rd-mux: route-slice-12 -> proxied request lacks header -> fallback route chosen -> 503```
Mike SRE: can we add x-rd-mux to the proxy whitelist as an emergency fix? minimal blast radius, reversible
Priya: we should also consider SDK side: if client lib produced mux header, SDK retry ought to reattach it on idempotent paths. that avoids trusting proxy whitelists forever
Jordan: agreed. two-part plan: 1) short-term: proxy whitelist x-rd-mux 2) medium-term: update SDK retry logic to persist/reinject mux header on safe retries
Alex: deploy-bot just posted canary rollback during the incidents — seeing reduced 503s after rollback but still some stragglers
deploy-bot: Canary rollout halted at 20% due to increased 5xx observed, automatic rollback initiated
Priya: for the SDK change we'll need a clear contract: which headers are considered immutable across retry? docs + tests + consent flag in console maybe?
Jordan: propose a small header policy: keep `x-rd-mux`, `x-rd-route-id`. anything else gets stripped. SDKs must expose opt-in flag `preserve_route_headers` default false for older versions, true for new major
Mike SRE: console folks will want telemetry to mark when requests lost mux on retry so we can correlate errors. can we add a sampling tag e.g., `route_header_preserved:true/false` in traces?
Priya: yes — platform tracing can emit `route_header_status` with values `preserved|dropped|unknown`. SDKs should populate on outgoing spans; proxies can add when they strip
Alex: QA checklist: unit tests for SDK retry + integration e2e with proxy whitelist toggled. Need canary in staging that preserves header to validate no perf hit
Jordan: timeline: proxy whitelist today (hotfix), SDK PR targeting py/ts this week, go next week, feature flag in console for rollout control, telemetry hook in traces
Priya: also doc change in devex: add migration note for apps relying on implicit header retention. include code snippets for py/ts showing how to enable preserve_route_headers
Mike SRE: i'll add trace attribute + dashboard tile showing % of requests where `route_header_status==dropped` across canaries
Alex: ok thanks all. tagging @Priya @Jordan for SDK follow-ups. i'll monitor error rates and post updates here
Priya: i'll open the py/ts PRs and ping this thread when ready
Jordan: will coordinate console feature flag and deploy-bot gating rules
Alex: closing loop: if errors spike after proxy whitelist revert, we escalate. otherwise we'll track on the SDK PRs
Priya: :thumbsup:
